sources.title: Base64.ai API
sources.snippet: The response contains the recognized document type (`model`), the data in the document (`fields`), and the confidence scores for the model and each field. P99 response time is under 1 second. Base64.ai can automatically recognize and organize the documents into categories called models.

sources.title: Base64.ai: AI-Powered Document Intelligence
sources.snippet: DOCUMENT INTELLIGENCE PLATFORM Convert any document—PDF, image, DOCX, and many others—into JSON Base64 identifies the document type, applies the right AI model, extracts all fields, and returns labeled JSON through one simple API call.
